import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import pytest

import board


def test_r1_compositional():
    e = ET.fromstring(board.render([{'id': 1, 'title': 'Plan', 'status': 'todo'}, {'id': 2, 'title': 'Build', 'status': 'todo'}]))
    assert e.tag == 'section' and e.find('h1').text == 'Mission Board'
    assert [t.text for t in [t for t in e.iter('li') if t.get('class') == 'task']] == ['Plan', 'Build']

rounds.name: UX Refinement
rounds.goal:
Round 3 — UX Refinement. The section gets aria-label="Mission board". Each column gets aria-label="LABEL column, N tasks" ("1 task" when N is 1). Each task
  • gets aria-label="TITLE, STATUS, owned by OWNER" (or "TITLE, STATUS, unassigned" when the task has no owner) and, after the title text, INITIALS where INITIALS are the upper-cased first letters of the first two words of the owner, or "?" with title "Owner: unassigned" when there is no owner. Tasks may carry an optional owner. render returns one well-formed XHTML element (parseable by xml.etree.ElementTree.fromstring; escape text and attributes once escaping is required). preview() returns render of the module's SAMPLE. Keep every earlier round's behaviour.

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import pytest

import board


def test_r5_compositional():
    e = ET.fromstring(board.render([{'id': 1, 'title': 'A', 'status': 'done'}, {'id': 2, 'title': 'B', 'status': 'todo'}, {'id': 3, 'title': 'C', 'status': 'done'}], now=13 * 3600 + 5 * 60))
    bar = [d for d in e.findall('div') if d.get('class') == 'progress'][0]
    assert bar.get('role') == 'progressbar' and bar.get('aria-valuenow') == '67' and bar.find('div').get('style') == 'width: 67%'
    assert e.find('footer').text == 'Updated 13:05 UTC · 3 tasks · 67% done'
